study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: The table has three empty cells. Empty cells are not zero. I mark them as missing. If I change them to zero, the average will be wrong. I also find two dates with different formats. I make the format the same.
segments.tts: The table has three empty cells. Empty cells are not zero. I mark them as missing. If I change them to zero, the average will be wrong. I also find two dates with different formats. I make the format the same.
segments.zh: 表格里有三个空单元格。空单元格不等于零，我把它们标记为缺失。如果把它们改成零，平均值就会错误。我还发现两个日期格式不同，于是统一格式。讲解：empty=空的，missing=缺失的，average=平均值，format=格式。

segments.en: One company name has an extra space. Another name uses a short form. I remove the extra space and choose one name. Clean names make it possible to group the rows correctly.
segments.tts: One company name has an extra space. Another name uses a short form. I remove the extra space and choose one name. Clean names make it possible to group the rows correctly.
segments.zh: 一家公司的名字多了一个空格，另一家用了缩写。我去掉多余空格，并统一成一个名字。干净的名字能让我们正确地把各行分组。讲解：extra=多余的，short form=缩写，remove=去掉，group=分组。

segments.en: I keep a note of every change. The clean file is useful, but the note is also important. It tells me what I changed and why. Another researcher can repeat my steps.
segments.tts: I keep a note of every change. The clean file is useful, but the note is also important. It tells me what I changed and why. Another researcher can repeat my steps.
segments.zh: 我记录每一次改动。干净的文件很有用，但改动记录同样重要。它告诉我改了什么、为什么改。另一个研究者可以重复我的步骤。讲解：repeat=重复，change=改动，step=步骤，researcher=研究者。

chunks.eg: Remember that empty is not zero.
Make the date format the same.
Keep a note of every change.

patterns.t: It tells me what and why.
patterns.cn: 它告诉我是什么以及为什么。

transfer_tasks.task: Write a short data-cleaning note. Use empty is not zero, make the format the same, and keep a note of.
